tools.name: list_people
tools.description: List people who can answer a decision in this workspace.

tools.name: list_internal_decisions
tools.description: Page through this workspace’s internal ask_person decisions. Filter by current status; notification state is separate from the answer.

tools.name: get_decision
tools.description: Read the latest answer or deadline status for one internal decision.

tools.name: get_approval
tools.description: Read one approval request, its current version, decisions, and delivery states.

tools.name: export_receipt
tools.description: Return the PDF record for a completed customer approval as an embedded document.

tools.name: wait_for_decision
tools.description: Wait up to 20 seconds for an internal answer or customer approval response. A pending timeout is not approval.

tools.name: list_approvals
tools.description: Page through this workspace’s approval requests and their recorded statuses.

tools.name: create_approval_request
tools.description: Save a customer quote or proof as a draft. This does not send an email.

tools.name: send_approval_request
tools.description: Email a confirmed draft to its customer. Recheck the current recipient and version before sending.

tools.name: add_revision
tools.description: Save a new unsent version after a customer requests changes. The prior sent version stays intact.

tools.name: advance_stage
tools.description: Email the customer a work-progress update after approval.

tools.name: cancel_approval
tools.description: Cancel a direct approval request and record why it was cancelled.

tools.name: ask_person
tools.description: Email a named person a decision link and record their response. Provide one person or personId.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_internal_decisions · Private data: export_receipt, cancel_approval, ask_person · Public sink: create_approval_request, send_approval_request, advance_stage, ask_person.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_internal_decisions · Private data: export_receipt, cancel_approval, ask_person · Public sink: create_approval_request, send_approval_request, advance_stage, ask_person

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
